scope: AI-assisted exploratory workflow using fixed-rule automated pseudo-labels. No independent reference accuracy or validated physiological rate is established.

parameters.known_artifacts: Existing stage-1 artifact supports are retained with the same 0.2 s preview margin; waveform states are not relaxed.
parameters.interpretation: Fixed exploratory proposals; six related parameter settings are not six independent annotators. Stability is not a correctness probability.

ai_visual_review_status: Completed visual screen of 24 selected overlays and diagnostic zooms; not event adjudication. Other windows receive automated proposals only.
rate_time_interpretation: Window time with an available provisional estimate, not independently validated usable time.
support_interpretation: Count of related parameter settings, not independent votes or correctness probability.
parameter_selection_context: Exploratory choices after prior inspection of this dataset; not preregistered or an independent validation set.
pulse_rate_interpretation: Descriptive median-interval estimates in windows meeting fixed rules; no ECG heart-rate, HRV, clinical or online-timing validation.
